description: Creates a group greeting card that several people sign before it opens on a set date, and returns the link to send to participants. Requires the organiser's email: the full management links are sent there, and a one-time 'take control' link is returned. Ask the person for anything missing; never invent an email. For Дарим (darim.ai) names are Russian; for Yahad (yahad.ai) Hebrew.

occasion.description: Occasion value from list_occasions, or a word like 'retirement'.

organizerEmail.description: Organiser's email. Required; ask the person, never guess.

promptQuestion.description: Optional question shown to participants; see suggest_prompts.

recipientGender.description: Optional: 'female' or 'male', used for Hebrew grammar.

recipientName.description: Who the card is for, as participants will see it.

revealDate.description: Date the card opens, YYYY-MM-DD, in the future.

revealTime.description: Time the card opens, HH:MM, 24-hour. Default 18:00.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Moscow. Default: the service's own.

name: create_board
title: Create a group card
